title: Which rounds and tests each change kind owes becomes rows in the agent-model-cap table, so a ruling change is a one-row edit (EXPRESS)
why: Owner 13:32 CST Nov 13 (relayed by the retrospective 13:33): "why is it changes to the tool require first passing through the tool why isn't it more straightforward are we doing something wrong".
source: owner 13:32 CST Nov 13, via retrospective 13:33 CST
note: EXPRESS (merge-flow, R55), todo, no lane yet. Cause (retrospective): the round rule lives in merge.py code, so a changed ruling waits for a code lane that the old code reviews. The model and effort per round are already data (decision agent-model-cap, "The round rows": a changed row changes their verdicts with no code edit); which rounds a change owes is not. Fix: which rounds and tests each change kind owes become rows in that table. A guard or check change: test-author red cases first, builder, reviewer. Related: merge-lint-fix-no-round-3, rounds-rules-one-record. Sighting 14:57 CST Nov 13 (coordinator 14:57, lane claim, unmeasured): merge --review-record accepts a Sonnet reviewer only, though the role row says Haiku, so lane red-main-owner-two-picks re-ran round 1 on Sonnet; lane receipt-close-express posted a Haiku round-1 line that was refused. If true, the tool and the agent-model-cap role row disagree on the round-1 model; this step (model from the row) may cover it. Not read by triage.
